page_title: SEV 1-1 ALA | Sevilla v Alaves 20/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Chance! Suso (Sevilla) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Juanlu Sanchez, but his shot from inside the box flashes just over the bar.
90+4' Suso (Sevilla) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Miguel Ortiz lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
90+2' The resulting corner from Carlos Vicente (Alaves) is cleared.

90+1' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball goes behind for a corner. Alaves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

89' That didn't go as planned! Carlos Vicente (Alaves) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Orjan Nyland, who easily kept it out.
88' Suso (Sevilla) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
86' A yellow card for a tackle by Moussa Diarra (Alaves). Miguel Ortiz doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
85' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) makes a strong challenge and Miguel Ortiz blows for a foul.
84' The Sevilla players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
82' Golden chance! Saul Niguez (Sevilla) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post.

81' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom left corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Antonio Sivera, who tips the ball around the post.
81' Joaquin Caparros Camino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Manuel Bueno Sebastian (Sevilla) replacing Peque.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jose Angel Carmona departs the field of play to be replaced by Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla).
80' The game is interrupted as Carlos Martin (Alaves) is flagged offside.
80' The resulting set piece from Alaves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
80' The attendance is 36436.
80' Carlos Martin (Alaves) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off. Corner kick. Alaves will have an opportunity.
78' Suso (Sevilla) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Joan Jordan trots off the pitch and is replaced by Ander Guevara (Alaves).
76' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
75' Half-chance! Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) plays a pass into the box, but Antonio Sivera reacts well to snuff out the attack.
74' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Orjan Nyland, who smothers the ball.
73' Miguel Ortiz interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Loic Bade (Sevilla).
72' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.

71' Tomas Conechny (Alaves) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Orjan Nyland sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom right corner.
70' The referee blows his whistle as Aleksandar Sedlar (Alaves) was too aggressive in his challenge.
69' Today's match ends for Carles Alena who will be replaced by Tomas Conechny (Alaves).
69' Here is a change. Jon Guridi is going off and Eduardo Coudet gives the last tactical orders to Carlos Martin (Alaves).
69' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle for a foul.
67' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
66' The resulting corner from Suso (Sevilla) is cleared by the defence.

66' Suso (Sevilla) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Sevilla.
65' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Saul Niguez (Sevilla) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar.
64' Kike Garcia (Alaves) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the right post.
63' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) is adjudged offside.
62' Loic Bade (Sevilla) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
60' Joaquin Caparros Camino has decided to make a change. Djibril Sow (Sevilla) replaces Lucien Agoume.
59' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Suso (Sevilla) will replace Isaac Romero.

57' Ambitious effort from Kike Garcia (Alaves). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the left post.
57' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Antonio Sivera comes off his line to intercept.
56' Joan Jordan (Alaves) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
55' Alaves control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
54' Moussa Diarra (Alaves) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
52' Joan Jordan (Alaves) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

52' Carles Alena (Alaves) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The linesman points to the corner flag, Alaves are going to take it.
52' Carles Alena (Alaves) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
51' Joan Jordan (Alaves) takes the corner with a short pass.

51' Kike Garcia (Alaves) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. Alaves force their opponents to concede a corner.
49' The cross into the penalty area from Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
48' Moussa Diarra (Alaves) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
46' Joan Jordan (Alaves) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Joaquin Caparros Camino probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Chidera Ejuke. He is replaced by Saul Niguez (Sevilla).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' 1 - 1 Goal! Carlos Vicente feeds Kike Garcia (Alaves), who taps the ball into an empty net. He makes it 1:1.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Kike Garcia (Alaves) serves up a nice cross, but Orjan Nyland punches the ball away.
43' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) receives a fine cross inside the box and attempts to score a goal, but his shot flies just wide of the right post.
43' The referee awards a corner and Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) goes over to take it.
43' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Sevilla.
42' Miguel Ortiz shows a yellow card to Jon Guridi (Alaves) for a tough tackle.
41' Joan Jordan (Alaves) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
40' The foul by Carles Alena (Alaves) was seen by Miguel Ortiz who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
38' Kike Garcia (Alaves) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.

37' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
36' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
34' Moussa Diarra (Alaves) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Miguel Ortiz saw the whole situation.
32' Joan Jordan (Alaves) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
32' A lofted cross from Carles Alena (Alaves) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Now Alaves have a corner.
31' Dangerous play by Joan Jordan (Alaves). Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle for a foul.
30' Jon Guridi (Alaves) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
29' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
28' Carles Alena (Alaves) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
26' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) meets a fine cross on the edge of the box from the resulting corner kick and shoots. His shot flies just wide of the left post.
26' Joan Jordan (Alaves) will take the corner.
25' Kike Garcia (Alaves) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Alaves will take a corner kick.
24' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Jon Guridi (Alaves) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
23' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
22' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
21' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
18' Antonio Sivera leaps to intercept the corner kick from Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla).
18' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. Sevilla get a corner.
17' Neat passing move from Sevilla in order to create new attacking opportunities.
16' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
15' Kike Garcia (Alaves) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
14' Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle. Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) commits a foul after dangerous play.
12' 1 - 0 Peque (Sevilla) latches on to a stunning cross and plants a header past the goalkeeper.
12' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
10' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) sees a yellow card from Miguel Ortiz after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
9' Half-chance! Kike Garcia (Alaves) plays a pass into the box, but Orjan Nyland reacts well to snuff out the attack.
8' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) plays a through ball but overhits it.
7' Alaves enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
5' Jon Guridi (Alaves) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.
3' A pass into the penalty area from Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) is intercepted by the defence.
2' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) makes a rough challenge and Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Sevilla will kick-off.
Miguel Ortiz is the one to supervise the game today.
